outline:
1.教授基本的電化學和原理
2.教授有關電子轉移（ET）反應的信息
3.使學生獲得循環伏安技術的知識
4.使學生習得功能性材料及電化學技術
5.了解電化學技術在科學，工程和技術領域的應用
schedule:
04/13 Unit	1 Electrode concept
Differences between bulk chemical reactions and electrochemical reactions; Electrode concept; Type of electrodes; Faradic and non-Faradic reactions; Electron-transfer reaction; Nernst Equation; Potentiometric measurement/sensing.

04/20 Unit	2. Electro-chemical reactions
Electrode-electrolyte interface; Electrolyte concept-Aqueous and Non-aqueous systems; Reversible, quasi-reversible and irreversible ET reactions-in general.

04/27 Unit	3. Cyclic voltammetry technique
Electrochemical behaviour of water, Fe(CN)3-/4-; Hydroquinone; Metal ions in solution and on surface (modified electrode surface); Diffusion controlled reaction; Adsorption controlled reaction-Examples.

05/04 Unit 4. Surface  modification techniques
Concept of physisorption, chemisorption, surface-confinement and heterogeneous electrodes; Electrocatalysis; Bio-electrocatalysis; Electrochemical Sensors.
